name: Welding & Joining Technology
summary: Fusion, solid-state and other joining processes, weld metallurgy, residual stress and distortion, inspection and welding codes.

topics.name: Welding heat sources, heat flow and heat input
Arc welding: SMAW, GMAW (MIG), GTAW (TIG), FCAW, SAW and plasma
Resistance welding: spot, seam and projection
High-energy-beam welding: laser and electron beam
Solid-state welding: friction, friction stir, ultrasonic and diffusion bonding
Welding metallurgy: fusion zone, heat-affected zone, weldability and preheat
Welding codes and qualification (WPS/PQR, AWS D1.1, ASME Section IX)
Joining dissimilar materials, plastics and composites
